full_judgment: 3. The plaintiff's case, inter alia, was that the suit land in the 'Ka' schedule of the plaint originally belonged to Ushabala Chakraborty the defendant No. 15. The plaintiff, Hashem Ali and his brother Kashem Ali the pro-defendant No. 22 took settlement of the suit land from the said owner, the defendant No. 15. in Baisakh, 1349 B.S. and since then they have been in possession of the same by exercising their title therein. The defendant Nos. 1-21 have got no title and possession of the suit land. But the defendant Nos, 1-7 instituted Title Suit No. 109 of 1970 against the defendant Nos. 8 21 on the false allegations in respect of the suit land & other lands. in that suit the defendant No. 1 claimed title over the suit land on the basis of (Pattan allegedly taken from the defendant No. 15 in. 1354 B.S. and on the basis of auction purchase held in .Certificate Case No. 60K/61-62. But as a matter of fact defendant No. 1 never took pattan of any land from the defendant No. 15 who left this country for India for good in 1349 B.S. No summonses were served upon the defendant in that suit All these were collusively and fraudulently suppressed No notice or sale proclamation was ever served or issued in the Certificate Case. The sale held in the certificate case was fraudulent and collusive. The defendant managed to obtain a sole decree, dated 16.4.70 in the said Title Suit No. 109 of 1970 by practicing fraud upon the court. The Solenama filed in that suit is a forged document the defendant No. 15 never appeared and effected any compromise. Neither the plaintiff nor his brother, the defendant No. 22, was made a party in that suit. The plaintiff came to know about the same in Chitra, 1378 B S. while the defendant No. 1 claimed title over the suit land on the basis of the said illegal sole decree.
